properties.note: Sample AOI polygon for portal testing (not a verified farm boundary). Rectangle defined via `ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-46.775, -19.26, -46.745, -19.23])`. Distinct from and located south of the sibling `coffee_brazil_minas_gerais.geojson` AOI; intended as a counterpart example expected to meet EUDR due-diligence requirements (no post-2020-12-31 forest-loss evidence on the analyzed land), pending reproduction against real pinned Hansen/JRC/Sentinel-2 evidence.
